```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggstatsplot)

# Load your data
df_flat_scores_final <- readRDS("full_dataset_with_items.rds")
dialogue_session_summary <- read_csv(
  'data/analysis_output/final_dialogue_summary.csv'
) |>
  mutate(exclusions = if_else(mean_comm_breakdown > .6, 'exclude', 'include'))

df_flat_scores_final <- df_flat_scores_final |>
  left_join(dialogue_session_summary, by = join_by(session_id)) |>
  mutate(
    post_trust = scales::rescale(
      post_trust,
      to = c(0, 100),
      min_old = 1,
      max_old = 5
    )
  )
```

<!-- Key Finding -->
::: {.box key-finding}
### 📊 Key Finding

```{r trust-plot}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false

ggplot(
  df_flat_scores_final |> filter(exclusions != 'exclude'),
  aes(x = group, y = post_trust, fill = group)
) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 5, color = "red") +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("CONTROL" = "#7A8DA0", "RESPONSIVE" = "#C98A6A")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  labs(
    y = "Trust Score (0-100)",
    x = "",
    title = "Responsive Policy Increased Trust"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)
  )
```

::: {.stat-highlight}
**+26 points higher trust**
**Task accuracy unchanged**
:::

:::

<!-- Mechanism -->
::: {.box mechanism}
### 🎯 Key Insights

**1. Process Over Outcomes**
Trust driven by interaction quality, not task performance

**2. Differential Sensitivity**
- ❤️ Affective trust → More sensitive to breakdown
- ✓ Reliability trust → Less sensitive

**3. Communication Matters**
Benefits require viable linguistic grounding

```{r mechanism-plot}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| warning: false

# Simple comparison of interaction characteristics
df_flat_scores_final |>
  filter(exclusions != 'exclude') |>
  select(
    group,
    Encouragement = prop_robot_encouragement,
    Empathy = prop_robot_empathy_expression,
    Collaborative = prop_robot_collaborative_lang
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "Behavior", values_to = "Proportion") |>
  group_by(group, Behavior) |>
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Behavior, y = mean_prop, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("CONTROL" = "#7A8DA0", "RESPONSIVE" = "#C98A6A")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    y = "% of Dialogue Turns",
    x = "",
    title = "Responsive Robot Behaviors",
    fill = "Policy"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
```

:::

<!-- Bottom takeaway -->
::: {.box takeaway}
### ⭐ Main Takeaway

**AI-based affect-adaptive robots increase trust through responsive interaction processes—even when task performance is unchanged—but only when communication remains viable.**

**Novel:** First fully autonomous affect-adaptive spoken-language HRI study

**Authors:** Shauna Heron & Meng Cheng Lau | Laurentian University
:::
